plainText:
Takaaki Uchino (Japanese: 内野孝聡 Uchino Takaaki) is a Japanese voice actor for .

==Biography==
Uchino was born sometime on April 10 in , . He became a voice actor as an adult and mostly got minor roles. He joined during , voicing Team Skull member Tupp for two episodes before being replaced by Toru Sakurai. Uchino is currently affiliated with the talent agency .

==Pokémon roles==
